title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the Dogtown district and surrounding corridors just steps from Drake University's campus.

cards.title: Mars Cafe
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this space-themed coffee shop for espresso and local art. It serves as a central hub for students and neighbors on the University Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A space-themed local coffee staple on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Mars Cafe is located at 2318 University Ave, Des Moines, IA 50311, and is a known local staple for coffee and artsy vibes.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from early morning until 7:00 PM.

cards.title: Drake Diner
cards.subtitle: 25th Street
cards.notes: Stop by this 1950s-style retro diner for all-day breakfast and classic comfort food. It is a landmark destination just south of the main campus.
cards.short_summary: An iconic 1950s-style retro diner on 25th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Diner is located at 1111 25th St, Des Moines, IA, and has been a landmark since 1987 serving all-day breakfast.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; hours vary with late closing on weekends.

cards.title: The Varsity Cinema
cards.subtitle: 25th Street
cards.notes: Catch an indie film or a classic at this renovated historic art house theater. It serves as a cultural anchor for the Dogtown district.
cards.short_summary: A historic nonprofit art house cinema on 25th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Varsity Cinema is located at 1207 25th Street, Des Moines, IA 50311, and reopened in 2022 as a nonprofit community art house.
cards.access_notes: Box office opens 30 minutes before the first show of the day.

cards.title: Jethro's BBQ
cards.subtitle: Forest Avenue
cards.notes: Dine at the original location of this famous Iowa BBQ chain. It is known for large portions and being a popular spot for watching Bulldog sports.
cards.short_summary: The original location of a famous Iowa BBQ chain on Forest Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Jethro's BBQ Drake is located at 3100 Forest Ave, Des Moines, IA, and is the original location of the chain.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner.

cards.title: xBk Live
cards.subtitle: 24th Street
cards.notes: Experience live music at this intimate 250-capacity venue. It hosts a wide range of genres and is a key part of the local performing arts scene.
cards.short_summary: An intimate live music and performing arts venue on 24th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: xBk Live is located at 1159 24th St, Des Moines, IA 50311, and is a 250-capacity venue for live experiences.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary based on scheduled performances; check their calendar for showtimes.

cards.title: Lucky Horse
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a burger and view the large Dogtown mural on the patio. This spot occupies the former site of a historic guitar shop in the heart of the district.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood burger joint with a signature Dogtown mural.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucky Horse Beer & Burgers is located at 2331 University Ave, Des Moines, IA 50311, and features a large Dogtown mural on its patio.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Dough Co. Pizza
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy New York-style thin-crust pizza by the slice or pie. It is a popular casual dining option for students located right on the University Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A New York-style pizzeria on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Dough Co. Pizza is located at 2330 University Ave, Des Moines, IA, and serves New York-style thin crust pizza.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner.

cards.title: University Library Cafe
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Try the famous nachos at this cozy neighborhood spot. Despite the name, it is a local eatery known for comfort food and a relaxed atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A cozy neighborhood eatery known for its nachos on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: University Library Cafe is located at 3506 University Ave, Des Moines, IA 50311, and is famous for its nachos.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; serves breakfast on weekends. Closes at 11:00 PM or 12:00 AM.

cards.title: Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: 25th Street
cards.notes: Shop for local produce and handmade goods at this seasonal market. It brings the community together every Wednesday afternoon during the summer months.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal community farmers market at 25th and University.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Neighborhood Farmers Market is held in the parking lot of First Christian Church at 25th and University on Wednesdays from June to September.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesdays, June through September, from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

cards.title: Anderson Gallery
cards.subtitle: 25th Street
cards.notes: Explore contemporary art exhibitions at this gallery located within the Harmon Fine Arts Center. It is free and open to the public during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary art gallery on the edge of campus at 25th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Anderson Gallery is located at 1310 25th St, at the corner of Carpenter and 25th, and offers free public admission.
cards.source_title: Drake University Anderson Gallery - Contact Us
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Sunday during exhibitions; closed Mondays and during university holidays.
